summary.text: Colby Watson is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District, a small business owner and Union County native running for office for the first time. He says he built a business with his brother that grew to employ more than 50 people. He describes his campaign as focused on ending corruption and money in politics, along with housing, health care costs, and farming.

paragraphs.text: Born in Indian Trail, North Carolina, within the 8th District; describes himself in his Ballotpedia survey as a lifelong North Carolinian, born and raised there.
Earned a high school diploma through homeschooling; WFAE reports he says he does not hold "a fancy degree."
Works as a small business owner. According to WFAE, he describes his work as a federal contractor and says he built a business with his brother that "grew to employ more than 50 people."
Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 47.9 percent of the vote over Kevin Clark and Jesse Oppenheim; he has not previously held elected office.
Describes himself as a husband and father; WFAE describes him as a father of two.
